scope: Programmer fixtures invoking real World/gameplay/scene/stream modules with compiled WASM. Native attachment is explicit for the Node host, not user-input evidence.

checks.name: World origin translation retains native handles and counters, including parented bodies and query coordinates
Gameplay origin shifts preserve navigation paths, absolute targets, cached grid and editor camera projection
Compiled native rope positions and cached records shift together without rebuilding constraints
Idle characters refresh removed floors through the gameplay path
Removed moving floors impart no stale platform velocity to idle characters
Scene prefetch installs no simulation bodies; activation installs actual queryable bodies and preserves authored disabled objects
Shared scene leases retain membership until the final active owner releases
Released scene handoffs preserve UUID, velocity and relative coordinates across later origin shifts
Malformed scenes, missing parents and live UUID conflicts reject without replacing existing membership
Chunk activation reaches native queries, deactivation removes them and authored child flags survive
Cancellation stays stopped across updates until Retry is requested
Dependencies prefetch before activation, cycles and missing cells fail without retry loops
In-flight admission waits for unload and never exceeds the authored memory budget
Source changes during a pending transition discard the old scene lease and activate the new source
Portal arrival uses the committed destination transform, prevents immediate bounce and reports missing targets
Measured repeated scene activation retires all temporary membership and preserves identity on replay
